scripts.zipwiki: pnpm --filter @zipwiki/api-client build && pnpm --filter @zipwiki/zipwiki exec tsx src/cli.ts
scripts.smoke:zipwiki: pnpm zipwiki -- open knowledge/sample-docs.zipwiki && pnpm zipwiki -- search knowledge/sample-docs.zipwiki deed
scripts.archive:test1: pnpm zipwiki -- stage knowledge/test1 --phase all -o knowledge/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --stage-dir knowledge/.stage/test1 -sf -T && pnpm extract:test1
scripts.archive:test2: pnpm zipwiki -- stage knowledge/test2 --phase all -o knowledge/.output/test2/test2.zipwiki --stage-dir knowledge/.stage/test2 -sf -T && pnpm extract:test2
scripts.archive:florida-laws: pnpm zipwiki -- pack "$HOME/Documents/florida-laws/2025-pdf" -r -o knowledge/florida-laws-2025.zipwiki --stage-dir knowledge/.stage/florida-laws --omit-original --include '*.pdf' --exclude .DS_Store --exclude '.zipwiki-origins.json' --exclude '*.url' --exclude '*.origin.json' --exclude MANIFEST.txt --exclude SUMMARY.json --origin-pattern 'Ch_(?<year>\d{4})-(?<chapter>\d+)' --origin-url-template 'https://laws.flrules.org/{year}/{chapter}' -sf -T
scripts.verify:florida-laws-origins: pnpm --filter @zipwiki/zipwiki exec node --input-type=module -e "import { openPackage } from './dist/lib/access/index.js'; const o=openPackage('../../knowledge/florida-laws-2025.zipwiki'); const rows=o.catalog.rows; const withUri=rows.filter(r=>r.originUri).length; const withOriginal=rows.filter(r=>r.hasOriginal).length; const uncovered=rows.filter(r=>!r.originUri&&!r.hasOriginal).map(r=>r.primary); console.log(JSON.stringify({primaries:o.primaryCount,originsWithUri:withUri,originalsInArchive:withOriginal,uncovered,sample:o.origins.slice(0,3)},null,2)); if(uncovered.length){console.error('missing origins'); process.exit(1)}"
scripts.sample-nzip: pnpm run archive:test1 && pnpm run archive:test2
scripts.archive: pnpm run archive:test1 && pnpm run archive:test2
scripts.archive:no-ocr: pnpm zipwiki -- stage knowledge/test1 --phase all -o knowledge/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --no-ocr --no-ai-okf --stage-dir knowledge/.stage/test1 -sf -T && pnpm extract:test1
scripts.archive:timestamp-parsed: pnpm zipwiki -- stage knowledge/test1 --phase all -o knowledge/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --parsed-date-from-original --no-ai-okf --stage-dir knowledge/.stage/test1 -sf -T && pnpm extract:test1
scripts.archive:no-okf: pnpm zipwiki -- stage knowledge/test1 --phase all -o knowledge/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --no-okf --stage-dir knowledge/.stage/test1 -sf -T && pnpm extract:test1
scripts.update:test1:add: pnpm zipwiki -- update knowledge/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --add knowledge/test2/property-deed.pdf --no-ai-okf --stage-dir knowledge/.stage/test1 && pnpm extract:test1 && pnpm list:test1
scripts.update:test1:del: pnpm zipwiki -- update knowledge/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --del bill-of-rights.pptx --stage-dir knowledge/.stage/test1 && pnpm extract:test1 && pnpm list:test1
scripts.update:test1:update: pnpm zipwiki -- update knowledge/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --update knowledge/test1-update/gettysburg-address.docx --no-ai-okf --stage-dir knowledge/.stage/test1 && pnpm extract:test1 && pnpm list:test1
scripts.read:test1:multi: pnpm zipwiki -- read -p knowledge/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --path wiki/okf/gettysburg-address.md --path wiki/okf/bill-of-rights.md
scripts.read:test2:multi: pnpm zipwiki -- read -p knowledge/.output/test2/test2.zipwiki --path wiki/okf/property-deed.md --path wiki/okf/introducing-neozip-cli.md
scripts.extract:florida-laws:origin: pnpm zipwiki -- extract knowledge/florida-laws-2025.zipwiki knowledge/.output/florida-laws --path wiki/parsed/Ch_2025-001.pdf.md --fetch-origin --overwrite
